questions.question: When King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon came to strike Egypt, who did the prophet Jeremiah say had thrown down Egypt's warriors?
God said Egypt would fall to King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon and his officers. What did He say would happen to Egypt afterward?

answers.text: It will be lived in as in days of old
It will stay empty for all time
It will be covered over by the sea

questions.question: While God warned of Egypt's punishment, what did He tell His servant Jacob, meaning the people of Israel?
God told His servant Jacob, the people of Israel, that He would leave them with no discipline at all. True or false?
